item_numbering_note: Source numbers items 1-18 then jumps to 24-35 (items 19-23 do not exist in this release - confirmed against the official item map on the last page of the PDF, which also skips 19-23, so this is not an extraction gap).

deferred_reasons.1: Requires placing arrows into a diagram (light-path model) from image-based arrow choices - visual-dependent, not restatable in text.
deferred_reasons.4: Requires placing constellation names into boxes based on reading positions from an orbital diagram - visual/diagram-dependent placement task, not a multiple-choice question.
deferred_reasons.6: Requires placing mineral names into a 3-circle Venn diagram - visual placement task, not multiple-choice.
deferred_reasons.8: Constructed-response (open-ended written answer) - skipped, same policy as prior batches.
deferred_reasons.18: Constructed-response (open-ended written answer) - also requires reading/comparing two hand-drawn wave diagrams for amplitude/wavelength.
deferred_reasons.25: Constructed-response (open-ended written answer, with an embedded checkbox table selection not itself multiple-choice in the pipeline's sense).

note: This extraction has an official answer key: the source PDF's own final page is a 'Grade 5 Released Questions - 2026 Elementary-level Science Test Map to the Standards' table giving the correct letter (Key column) for every multiple-choice item, plus its Performance Expectation and subscore domain (PS/LS/ESS). All 18 usable items' correct answers below are copied directly from that official key, not independently reasoned - same evidentiary standard as the 2024/2025 NY science batches already merged.
